1.hook: Frame 0 = subject already mid-pose on a lit stage; 'Main character energy only!' caption
1.text: Small white pill caption top-centre, sentence case + emoji; stays all video
1.grade: Warm pink/red stage wash, lifted blacks, soft
1.camera: Static wide, centred; one punch-in mid-way
1.lesson: Identity caption ('main character energy') + solo stage moment = strong, simple hook for her Garba/dance solos

2.hook: Text hook 'The best kind of surprise?' over subject already moving
2.text: Bold white top text with italic accent; two-line setup
2.grade: Cool blue spotlight vs warm decor; high contrast
2.lesson: Question-style text hook creates curiosity before payoff

3.hook: Opens on black then cuts to dancer: weak first frame
3.grade: Neutral studio, black drape backdrop makes costume pop
3.camera: Static wide + medium close-ups of expression
3.lesson: Black drape isolates traditional chaniya choli colour; alternate wide/close on expressions

4.hook: Close-up of bride's face reacting on phone: emotion first
4.camera: Tight close-ups → reveal wide of groom
4.lesson: Lead with the emotional reaction close-up, reveal the cause after

5.hook: Performer already dancing in floral setup
5.lesson: Florals + practical lights = premium event look with phone footage

6.hook: Couple on lavish stage, location tag sticker 'Raffles Udaipur'

7.hook: Wide-angle selfie close to lens, high energy
7.camera: Wide-angle handheld, very close, whip pans
7.lesson: Ultra-wide close-to-lens POV conveys crowd energy (use for garba night crowd shots)

9.hook: Group frozen in pose with top caption
9.text: White caption top in pill, Hinglish
9.lesson: Freeze-pose opening then burst into movement

10.hook: Bride solo centred among guests in ornate hall

11.hook: Couple mid-move under neon floor lights
11.lesson: Neon dance-floor lighting gives energy; keep skin tones protected when grading neon

12.hook: Gujarati-script caption '1, નંબર આવી જાવ રમવા' over garba circle
12.text: Gujarati script white text top: native-language hook
12.lesson: Gujarati-script hook line works natively for Gujarati audience: validates our hero-text choice

13.lesson: BTS format: show the making of a reel = authentic lifestyle content

14.hook: Black first frame (weak), then two girls in coordinated lehengas
14.lesson: Coordinated outfits for duo dances make frame pop; avoid black frame 0

15.lesson: Low production stage capture: example of what NOT to post raw (needs crop/punch-ins)

16.hook: Bride-to-be in sash, cake, sunglasses reveal
16.lesson: Prop reveal (sunglasses on) as a beat moment

18.hook: Friends lined up on cliff; Hindi lyric caption in yellow box
18.text: Yellow box with black text: high-contrast lyric caption
18.lesson: Yellow-box lyric caption = readable over busy backgrounds; friends trend dance format

19.hook: Crowd on LED floor; two-line white text top
19.lesson: Crowd-level camera amid dancers makes viewer feel inside the party

21.hook: Trio in matching red sarees, fairy-light backdrop
21.lesson: Matching saree trio + fairy lights = premium Bollywood look achievable at home

22.lesson: Saree twirl as a natural transition point

23.hook: Audience reaction close-up first, then performers
23.lesson: Intercutting audience reactions raises perceived impact of a performance

24.lesson: Centre framing with symmetrical stage lights

25.hook: Relatable caption 'When a sister is fight ...' over home scene
25.lesson: Gujju-girl relatable skit; punch-in close-up on the punchline face

26.lesson: Low-effort conversational format with strong personality

27.lesson: Casual home trend dance: low production but personality-led

28.hook: Woman in red kurta on purple-lit set
28.lesson: Bold outfit vs complementary backdrop colour

29.reason: Low-production male crowd clip; little editing value
